steps.title: Unlock preserve (get 70 pray if …
steps.text: Unlock preserve (get 70 pray if you only got 43 at the start)
steps.note: Offer bones at a gilded altar in a POH with both incense burners lit (fastest); Chaos altar in the Wilderness is ~half the cost.

steps.title: Buy combat gear: b ring, fury, …
steps.text: Buy combat gear: b ring, fury, manacles, granite hammer, Regen brace, (inquis helm), full obby + shield, sword and berserker necklace

steps.title: Train melees to 65 att, 65 …
steps.text: Train melees to 65 att, 65 str and 60 def at sand crabs (granite hammer till 60 att, then d scim till 65/65/60 + use super combat pots
steps.note: Nightmare Zone Normal Rumble north of Yanille - very AFK with absorption + overload potions (needs ~5 quests).

steps.title: Get dragon defender (full obby + …
steps.text: Get dragon defender (full obby + berserker neck) (train strength)

steps.title: Get 30 firemaking
steps.note: 1-tick make redwood/rosewood pyre logs (needs Shades of Mort'ton) for fastest XP; else burn coloured/firelighter logs.

steps.title: Get 30 runecraft
steps.note: Craft lava runes at the Fire Altar (essence + earth runes, wear a binding necklace) - fastest solo; or play Guardians of the Rift.

steps.title: Get 31 crafting
steps.note: Cut gems for fastest XP: sapphire -> emerald -> ruby -> diamond; keep cutting diamonds to 62.

steps.title: Get 30 slayer (black mask, cannon)
steps.note: Take tasks from Mazchna in Canifis (20 combat) - use the highest master your combat level allows.

steps.title: Get 36 woodcutting
steps.note: Chop teak trees - 1.5-tick teaks on Fossil Island is the fastest in game. AFK/no-tick: teaks to 65 then sulliuscep mushrooms.
